report.title: Mountain Springs Mutual Water Company Consumer Confidence Report - 2025 (dated May 14, 2026; prepared by Weber, Hayes and Associates)

sources_described: January to December 2025 water came from San Jose Water Company's (SJWC) Montevina pipelines (treated surface water, chloraminated by SJWC; MSMWC removes the chloramines and re-chlorinates on site). The on-site production well (-001, ~230 ft deep) is a disconnected backup source that was not used for drinking water in 2025 but was tested.
search_log: WebSearch '"Mountain Springs Mutual Water Company" Los Gatos consumer confidence report water quality' -> no hits for this system (only Redwood Lodge, King's Mountain Park, SJWC)

Drinking Water Watch search https://sdwis.waterboards.ca.gov/PDWW/JSP/SearchDispatch?number=CA4300740 -> system detail tinwsys_is_number=4246; Consumer Confidence Reports menu lists 2025 Report (certification not available), 2024 and 2023 Report+Certification
https://ear.waterboards.ca.gov/Home/ViewCCR?PwsID=CA4300740&Year=2024&isCert=false -> PDF also available (2024 data year); not used because 2025 exists

extraction_notes: No violations: report states 'Source water supplied to and distributed in the system met all EPA and State drinking water standards.' Table 1 (PDF pages 7-9, printed '1 of 3'..'3 of 3') is the backup well (-001), a disconnected source not used in 2025; Table 2 (PDF page 10) is the distribution system carrying SJWC Montevina water. Both tables have a single RESULT column headed '(ppm)' with no PHG column, so phg_printed is null throughout; units are ppm except Color (Units), Odor (T.O.N), pH (pH units), Turbidity (NTU), Gross Alpha (MCL cell says pCi/L) and Specific Conductivity (no unit printed). Several analytes list multiple dated results (2018-2025); every printed date/result line is kept as its own entry with sample_year set from the date, so the pipeline should prefer the latest sample_year per analyte. Superscript footnote markers on MCLs ('2' = secondary, '2a' = EPA secondary, 'a' = MCL no longer in effect) were dropped from mcl_printed and described in notes. The report prints Nitrite (as N) MCL as 10 and Nitrate+Nitrite (as N) MCL as 1, apparently swapped; copied as printed. Lead and copper in Table 2 are five individual tap results each (no 90th percentile), kept as five entries each. Hexavalent chromium result 0.00014 ppm (= 0.14 ppb) is dated 3/28/25. Coliform rows are presence/absence ('Absent'), stored as not detected with null unit.
